answer: Resist sybils with synchronous co-presence puzzles: each identity joins four random strangers for a ten-minute task needing real-time replies and a joint solution. First, groups are drawn at an unannounced minute. Second, members must answer each prompt within 60 seconds. Third, all five co-sign, and a no-show suspends the identity 30 days. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 operators online at once, costing $600,000 in wages for 50,000 sessions a month. Like a meadow blooming only when every stream reaches the summit oasis together, one operator cannot be in ten thousand places at once.
